title: Reading the Orders page in four parts
footer: An invented shop-app admin screen, drawn for this demo

steps.title: The Orders page shows what needs you today
text: Four counters, one alert and the latest orders.

steps.title: Failed payments are counted for the last hour
text: A red number means card payments are failing right now.
Anything above zero is worth a look.

steps.title: Retry every failed payment with one button
text: The customers were not charged, so a retry is safe.
Orders that go through turn Paid.

steps.title: Status says where each order stands
text: A failed one stays in the list until it is paid or cancelled.
